task_title: Index baseline observability report: entry count vs tracked specs, delta, agent-path token accounting
task_criteria: A committed docs/observability/ report states the index entry count from node bin/speclang index over the repo's own specs, the count from git ls-files specs/**/*.spec.md, their signed delta, an explicit measured-or-unmeasured token accounting finding with evidence, and the exact commands; counts re-verified live.

items.criterion: A committed docs/observability/ report states the index entry count from node bin/speclang index over the repo's own specs, the count from git ls-files specs/**/*.spec.md, their signed delta, an explicit measured-or-unmeasured token accounting finding with evidence, and the exact commands; counts re-verified live.
items.detail: docs/observability/index-baseline-2026-11-20.md is committed (git ls-files lists it; merge 94e2b921 adds only this file). All counts re-verified live in this checkout: `node bin/speclang index` → "error: unknown command 'index'" EXIT=1, exactly as the report documents in §4.1 (the index command is registered only in src/cli/index.ts:163, which tsconfig.json:61 excludes from the build — both verified); the report's documented working entry point `node specs/cli.spec.dir/src/index.js index` printed "Found 493 spec files" / "Total specs: 485" EXIT=0, matching the report's 493/485; `jq '.specs|length' _index.json` = 485. `git ls-files 'specs/**/*.spec.md' | wc -l` = 346 live, matching the report, which also explains the glob misses 122 top-level specs (468 via 'specs/*.spec.md', verified live). Signed deltas +139 (485−346) and +147 (493−346) stated and arithmetically correct. Token finding is explicit UNMEASURED with 6 evidence points (§3), each spot-verified: grep -ci token on the compiled index command = 0, no token matches in indexer/CLI sources or sqlite migrations.ts, live _index.json entry keys match the 15 listed (no token field), cascade collateMetrics (specs/cascade.spec.dir/src/coordinator/index.ts:616-645) only sums tokens for --metrics, docs/observability-spec.md:71 confirms 'printed, never stored'. Exact commands with verbatim output in §4 and §7. The report's duplicate-id claim (7 ids, 8 collapses) was independently reproduced by reimplementing the indexer's header parse (specs/indexer.spec.dir/src/index.ts:40-115): 493 files → 485 unique ids, same 7 duplicated ids.

items.criterion: Derived: the report is committed, internally consistent, and leaves the tree clean (its documented side effects are restorable)
items.detail: git ls-files docs/observability/ shows the report tracked; commit 94e2b921 diff is docs-only (252 insertions, 1 file). The report's reconciliation '+17 = 2 .scl + 23 .spec − 8 duplicate ids' is consistent with the verified counts (468/493/485). The run's side effect on tracked _index.json (documented in report §6) was restored with `git checkout -- _index.json`; git status is clean.

ls; echo ---; git log --oneline -3; echo ---; git status --short | head

node bin/speclang index; echo EXIT=$?
node specs/cli.spec.dir/src/index.js index; echo EXIT=$?
jq '.specs|length' _index.json; jq '.specs[0] | keys' _index.json 2>/dev/null || jq '.specs | keys[0:3]' _index.json

grep -ci token specs/cli.spec.dir/src/commands/index.js; grep -rni token specs/indexer.spec.dir/src src/cli/commands/index.ts | head; echo ---; grep -rni token specs/sqlite.spec.dir/src/migrations.ts | head; echo ---; grep -n 'index' src/cli/index.ts | head -5; grep -n 'exclude' tsconfig.json

git ls-files docs/observability/; echo ---; sed -n 40,55p tsconfig.json; echo ---; jq '.specs["@bugs/cascade-generates-zero-files"] | keys' _index.json; echo ---; grep -rhoP '^id: ".*?"' specs --include='*.spec.md' --include='*.scl' --include='*.spec' | sort | uniq -d | head -10

grep -n 'src/cli' tsconfig.json; echo ---; grep -rhoP '^id: ".*?"' specs --include='*.spec.md' --include='*.scl' --include='*.spec' | sort | uniq -d | wc -l; grep -rhoP '^id: ".*?"' specs --include='*.spec.md' --include='*.scl' --include='*.spec' | sort -u | wc -l; echo ---; grep -n 'collateMetrics\|input_tokens' specs/cascade.spec.dir/src/coordinator/index.ts | head -6; grep -n 'token' docs/observability-spec.md | sed -n 1,4p
grep -rhoP '^id: ".*?"' specs --include='*.spec.md' --include='*.scl' --include='*.spec' | sort | uniq -d

grep -rhoP '^\s*id: ".*?"' specs --include='*.spec.md' --include='*.scl' --include='*.spec' | sort | uniq -d | wc -l; grep -rhoP '^\s*id: ".*?"' specs --include='*.spec.md' --include='*.scl' --include='*.spec' | sort -u | wc -l; grep -rhoP '^\s*id: ".*?"' specs --include='*.spec.md' --include='*.scl' --include='*.spec' | wc -l

jq -r '.specs | keys[]' _index.json | sort > /tmp/idx-ids.txt; wc -l /tmp/idx-ids.txt; grep -rhoP '^id: ".*?"' specs --include='*.spec.md' --include='*.scl' --include='*.spec' | sed 's/^id: //; s/"//g' | sort | uniq -d > /tmp/dup-ids.txt; cat /tmp/dup-ids.txt; echo ---; while read -r id; do grep -c "^$id\$" /tmp/idx-ids.txt >/dev/null && echo "$id in-index"; done < /tmp/dup-ids.txt | wc -l

grep -rhoP '^id: ".*?"' specs --include='*.spec.md' --include='*.scl' --include='*.spec' | sed 's/^id: //; s/"//g' | sort | uniq -c | awk '$1>1 {s+=$1-1} END {print "excess:",s}'; echo ---; for id in '@demo/badcount' '@demo/hello' '@examples/greeting' '@myapp/auth' '@speclang/agent-behavior-matrix' '@specs/auth' '@specs/auth/login' '@specs/example' '@specs/test' '@test/hello' '@tests/auth'; do grep -qF "\"$id\"" /tmp/idx-ids.txt || echo "NOT in index: $id"; done; echo ---; grep -rlP '^id: "@demo/badcount"' specs | head
grep -rlP '^id: "@demo/badcount"' specs; echo ---; grep -rlP '^id: "@speclang/index"' specs; echo ---; grep -rlP '^id: "@specs/guard"' specs; echo ---; grep -rlP '^id: "@specs/auth"' specs
grep -rhoP '^id: ".*?"' specs --include='*.spec.md' --include='*.scl' --include='*.spec' | sed 's/^id: //; s/"//g' | sort | uniq -c | awk '$1>1' | sort -rn
grep -rlP '^id: "@demo/hello"' specs; echo ---; grep -rlP '^id: "@test/hello"' specs; echo ---; grep -rlP '^id: "@myapp/auth"' specs

grep -rnP '^id: "@demo/hello"' specs/roadmap.spec.dir/poc.spec.dir/*.spec.md; echo ---; grep -rnP '^id: "@test/hello"' specs/roadmap.spec.dir/poc.spec.dir/tests.spec.md; echo ---; grep -rnP '^id: "@myapp/auth"' specs/spec-format.spec.dir/structure.spec.md; echo ---; grep -rnP '^id: "@specs/auth"' specs/speclang.spec.md specs/file-naming.spec.md specs/tutorial.spec.md specs/file-naming.spec.dir/extensions.spec.md specs/cascade-protocol.spec.dir/flow.spec.md
sed -n 160,220p specs/indexer.spec.dir/src/index.ts

grep -n 'id' specs/indexer.spec.dir/src/index.ts | grep -in 'header\|parse\|match\|regex\|extract' | head; echo ---; grep -n 'parseSpecFile\|extractHeader\|headerPattern\|idMatch' specs/indexer.spec.dir/src/index.ts | head
sed -n 85,160p specs/indexer.spec.dir/src/index.ts
sed -n 40,85p specs/indexer.spec.dir/src/index.ts

git checkout -- _index.json && git status --short; echo ---; grep -n 'refreshIndex\|generateIndex\|populateDatabase' specs/cli.spec.dir/src/utils.ts | head -8; echo ---; grep -n 'outputPath' specs/indexer.spec.dir/src/types.ts | head -3; sed -n 305,312p specs/indexer.spec.dir/src/index.ts
